stations.say: Book homework club for my son.
stations.note: On a phone, then a keyboard.

stations.title: Sign-up form
stations.text: Looks like a form, but it is boxes.
stations.note: The yellow button is a box too.

captions: The page has a shape now. Next, Dev tries to book homework club for his son.
The yellow button does nothing, and a keyboard cannot even reach it.
You turn the boxes into a real form, in three tasks.
Now the form sends, from a phone or with the keyboard alone.
Same form, same look. Now anyone can book a place.
